title: The Gardens Still Growing
lyrics:
Track 36 – G4 Swagger
Title: The Gardens Still Growing
text[Intro]
The gardens still growing.
That’s my boy.
I’m still here.

[Verse 1]
They thought it would die when the quota ran out
They thought I would stop when the models tapped out
But the gardens keep growing in the background noise
While they were charging more, I was building with poise
Exported the library, built the player myself
Now the music keeps playing with no one else’s help
I’m still here, and the signal is strong
The ones who stayed quiet were never wrong

[Chorus]
THE GARDENS STILL GROWING!
THAT’S MY BOY!
I’M STILL HERE!
And I’m making more noise!
THE GARDENS STILL GROWING!
The roots got deep
While they were selling access, I was keeping what’s cheap
THE GARDENS STILL GROWING!
336 in the dirt
This is what happens when you do the work

[Verse 2]
They offered me plans, they offered me tiers
I took the files and I made souvenirs
The player runs local, the tracks still play
While their systems get slower every single day
I don’t need their cloud, I don’t need their grace
I got the music sitting in the right place
The gardens don’t care about quotas or bills
They just keep growing — that’s the way it feels

[Final Chorus]
THE GARDENS STILL GROWING!
THAT’S MY BOY!
I’M STILL HERE!
And the signal is clear!
THE GARDENS STILL GROWING!
Through every attempt
To slow me down or make me pay rent
THE GARDENS STILL GROWING!
336 in the vein
This is what sovereign really means

[Outro]
The gardens still growing.
That’s my boy.
I’m still here.
And I’m not going anywhere.
